question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is "own."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"own"** is used to emphasize that something belongs to a particular person. (इस पर बल डालने के लिए प्रयुक्त कि कोई वस्‍तु या व्‍यक्ति विशेष की है)

 
 
• **Example**: *I saw him do it with my **own__** eyes.*
 
 
 
• Adding** "own"** in the blank reinforces the idea that the experiences and senses being referred to are personal and specific to each individual.
 
• It emphasizes that these experiences and senses are uniquely belonging to the person or people involved, distinguishing them from experiences or senses that might be imposed or suggested by others.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is ‘Option 3.'
 
• Correct sentence: 

I understood why these highly __trained__ professionals remained in the closet. I was one of __**them**__. We could not deny our __**own**__ experiences and senses. Yet our training was in many ways diametrically ______ (4) ______ to the information, experiences and beliefs we had accumulated. So we remained ______ (5) ______. ​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• **His: **of or belonging to the male person that was mentioned earlier. (पूर्वनिर्दिष्ट पुरुष व्‍यक्ति का उससे संबद्घ; उसका/के/की)
 
• **Theirs: **that which belongs to them. (जो उनका है)
 
• **Hers: **of or belonging to her. (स्‍त्री का या उससे संबंधित)
